🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX (1W: +0.13% | 1M: -8.18%) RECOVERY → flat and a split equities-vs-bonds signal with SPY (1W: -0.46% | 1M: -1.55%) BELOW TREND vs TLT (1W: +1.58% | 1M: +2.40%) ABOVE TREND, supporting a neutral regime.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit and volatility steady: HYG (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +0.24%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.85% | 1M: +0.78%) ABOVE TREND → HYG/LQD neutral; VXX neutral (see above). Gold weakening: GLD (1W: -4.16% | 1M: -10.71%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-cautious: TLT (1W: +1.58% | 1M: +2.40%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising while SPY (1W: -0.46% | 1M: -1.55%) BELOW TREND shows equities under mild pressure.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Healthcare and biotech leading: XBI (1W: +8.54% | 1M: +16.53%) ABOVE TREND and XLV (1W: +7.12% | 1M: +7.00%) ABOVE TREND; Tech lagging: XLK (1W: -3.51% | 1M: -0.65%) BELOW TREND. Style mixed / no clear leadership given mixed financials (XLF (1W: +0.04% | 1M: +5.15%) ABOVE TREND but weak 1W sector breadth).

5. US vs Global?
US mixed: SPY (1W: -0.46% | 1M: -1.55%) BELOW TREND vs IWM (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +2.62%) ABOVE TREND. EM/China weakening: EEM (1W: -5.31% | 1M: -1.21%) BELOW TREND and FXI (1W: -5.15% | 1M: -8.69%) BELOW TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Uneven: ARKK (1W: +2.81% | 1M: -0.47%) RECOVERY showing selective risk-on, while IBIT (1W: -6.36% | 1M: -17.76%) BELOW TREND and ETHA (1W: -6.28% | 1M: -19.42%) BELOW TREND show crypto pullback.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Broad weakness: CPER (1W: -4.07% | 1M: -4.69%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling; precious metals under pressure with SLV (1W: -10.58% | 1M: -22.94%) BELOW TREND and GLD (see above) BELOW TREND.

8. Energy Trend?
Downbeat: XLE (1W: -0.89% | 1M: -5.24%) BELOW TREND and BNO (1W: -5.26% | 1M: -20.42%) BELOW TREND; UNG (1W: -2.89% | 1M: -3.87%) BELOW TREND.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed pockets: XBI and XLV both ABOVE TREND (1W and 1M positive). Divergences are present but not systemic: SOXX (1W: -6.21% | 1M: +7.93%) CORRECTION and MTUM (1W: -2.67% | 1M: +6.90%) CORRECTION signal short-term rotational noise.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor exposure to healthcare/biotech and quality fixed income; reduce exposure to commodities and China equity ETFs; monitor tech (XLK) for further downside.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XBI (1W: +8.54% | 1M: +16.53%) ABOVE TREND, XLV (1W: +7.12% | 1M: +7.00%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: SLV (1W: -10.58% | 1M: -22.94%) BELOW TREND, BNO (1W: -5.26% | 1M: -20.42%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: none obvious given current data. BEARISH: CPER (1W: -4.07% | 1M: -4.69%) BELOW TREND, SLV (see above) BELOW TREND, BNO (see above) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 20 (complacency threshold); HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health); XLK/XLF 2.0 (growth vs value pivot); SPY support zone aligned with BELOW TREND readings.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive.  
Healthcare/biotech (XBI, XLV) showing strength while Tech (XLK) is weak.  
Key risk: continued divergence between bond strength (TLT ABOVE TREND) and softening broad equities (SPY BELOW TREND), monitor SOXX and momentum corrections.
